Nagless test pages

Use a normal tab (extensions don't run in private browsing). Every "BLOCK" page should also show the "Popup blocked — Undo" chip at the bottom for ~5 seconds; tapping Undo must bring the popup back and keep it until you reload.

PageSuccess looks like
scroll-modal
BLOCK		 Scroll down ~2 screens. The newsletter modal + dark backdrop vanish (or never land), the chip appears, and you can keep scrolling.
autofocus-email
BLOCK		 Scroll down ~2 screens. Modal gone and — the big one — the keyboard never pops up (or dismisses instantly).
timed-modal
BLOCK		 Wait ~1.5s. The full-screen "Special offer" interstitial disappears right after it appears; page still scrolls.
fixed-body-lock
BLOCK		 Scroll a bit, wait ~1.5s. Modal gone and the page stays at your scroll position (this lock variant normally teleports you to the top).
display-toggle
BLOCK		 Wait ~1.5s. The pre-hidden modal is un-hidden by the page but never visibly appears (or vanishes immediately); scrolling stays unlocked.
late-injection
BLOCK		 Wait ~3s. The nested "Subscribe today" dialog disappears shortly after injection.
login-wall
BLOCK		 An Instagram-style "log in to continue" wall covers the page from load. It vanishes within a second; the page behind is readable.
login-wall-desktop
BLOCK		 Desktop-app-style wall (no fixed positioning) plus a separate dimming layer. Both vanish; the page scrolls and is clickable.
deep-dom-wall
BLOCK		 A sign-up wall buried past ~1,400 elements of a large page (like X.com). It should vanish — proves big pages are scanned fully.
video-player
KEEP		 A sticky video player pinned to the top stays — video players are never blocked, even when the site focuses their controls.
cookie-banner
KEEP		 The small bottom cookie bar stays visible the whole time — Nagless must not touch it.
user-modal
KEEP		 Tap "Open settings". The modal opens and stays open — modals you asked for are never blocked.
